## Load Dataset

```{r loading, include=TRUE}
library(writexl)
dataset_name <- file.path(getwd(), "breast-cancer-wisconsin.data")
data_names <- c("Sample code number", "Clump Thickness", "Uniformity of Cell Size", "Uniformity of Cell Shape", "Marginal Adhesion", "Single Epithelial Cell Size", "Bare Nuclei", "Bland Chromatin", "Normal Nucleoli", "Mitoses", "Class")

BCWData <- read.csv(dataset_name, col.names = data_names, sep=",", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
```

## Question 1

Remove the case with missing values and change Bare.Nuclei from chr to int

```{r data_update, echo=FALSE}
updated_BCWData <- BCWData[-grep("?", BCWData$Bare.Nuclei, fixed=TRUE), ]

updated_BCWData$Bare.Nuclei <- as.integer(updated_BCWData$Bare.Nuclei)
```

## Question 2

Check which ones are Benign and which one is Malignant
```{r balance_data, echo=FALSE}
bein_data <- which(updated_BCWData$Class=="2")
mal_data <- which(updated_BCWData$Class=="4")
```

Since Malignant tumors are less common, we will under sample ?benign? tumors to adjust for imbalance for the dataset

```{r balance_data, echo=FALSE}
#To ensure consistency
set.seed(1234)
nsamp <- length(mal_data)
pick_bein <- sample(bein_data, nsamp)

BCWData_balanced <- as.data.frame(updated_BCWData[c(pick_bein,mal_data),])
```

## Question 3

```{r PCA, echo=FALSE}
cancer_PC<-prcomp(BCWData_balanced, scale.=TRUE) #the scaled PCA 
summary(cancer_PC)
```

## Exporting Original dataset, dataset without missing variables, and dataset undersampled
```{r Dataset to Excel}
write_xlsx(BCWData, "original_BWCdata.xlsx")
write_xlsx(updated_BCWData, "BWCData_wo_missing.xlsx")
write_xlsx(BCWData_balanced, "BWCData_undersampled.xlsx")
```

## Export Variable
Save the variable to an External File. Easier for other files to using the variable.

```{r Export, echo=FALSE}
save(cancer_PC, file = "cancer_PC.RData")
save(BCWData_balanced, file = "BCWData_balanced.RData")
```
